name: ch-bias-detector
description: Distributed bias-detection system: 3 detector microservices + orchestrator (debate/judge) over local Ollama

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix services/omission install && npm --prefix services/framing install && npm --prefix services/fear install && npm --prefix services/voiceweb install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n orch,omission,framing,fear -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix services/omission run dev" "npm --prefix services/framing run dev" "npm --prefix services/fear run dev"
scripts.voiceweb: concurrently -n voiceweb,client -c cyan,green "npm --prefix services/voiceweb run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n orch,omission,framing,fear -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix services/omission start" "npm --prefix services/framing start" "npm --prefix services/fear start"
